control_name: Internal data fields map to the ACORD data dictionary
control_objective: Every internal data field that participates in carrier, agency, or regulatory exchange is mapped to a corresponding element in the ACORD data dictionary so that semantics are preserved across the integration estate.
risk_addressed: Internal fields with no ACORD mapping introduce semantic drift, force bespoke point-to-point transforms, and cause data-quality and reconciliation failures when policy, claim, and billing data cross system boundaries.

applies_to: Internal data fields in exchange-bound entities

required_data_elements.business_definition: An internal data field registered in the schema registry for an exchange-bound entity.
The documented mapping from an internal field to its ACORD data-dictionary element.

method.summary: Reconcile registered internal fields against documented ACORD data-dictionary mappings and flag any unmapped field.
steps: Enumerate internal fields for exchange-bound entities from the schema registry.
Load the documented ACORD data-dictionary mappings from the mapping specifications.
Identify internal fields with no ACORD data-dictionary mapping.
Compute dictionary mapping coverage as a percentage of internal fields.
method.fallback_logic: If either source is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any unmapped internal field weakens canonical semantics across exchanges.
thresholds.warning_threshold: Any internal field lacking an ACORD mapping
thresholds.escalation_threshold: Mapping coverage below the agreed canonical baseline

pass_criteria: Every internal field maps to an ACORD element.
Full data-dictionary mapping coverage is achieved.
warning_criteria: Some internal fields are not yet mapped to the ACORD data dictionary.
fail_criteria: Mapping evidence cannot be produced for the field population.
exception_handling: Open a data-dictionary mapping gap issue.
Author the missing mappings and re-test.

assertions.description: Every internal field maps to an ACORD element.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each quarter as the canonical model evolves.

actions_on_fail: Notify Data Architect and Data Steward
